title: Bare Bones x The Road More Travelled
description: Adds Bare Bones-style textures to The Roads More Travelled
body: A [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones) compatibility addon for [The Roads More Travelled](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-roads-more-travelled). This pack retextures [TRMT](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-roads-more-travelled)'s erosion and path blocks to match the vibrant, simplified style of [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones), ensuring your roads feel right at home in a trailer-inspired world.
